myproperty_building.description: One row per managed building within each branch (property management system).

totalBlocks.description: Number of blocks or towers in this building

totalFloors.description: Total number of floors in the building

totalArea.description: Total area (m²) covered by this building

constructionYear.description: Year the building was constructed or commissioned

status.description: Building operational status: ACTIVE / INACTIVE / UNDER_MAINTENANCE

myproperty_invoice.description: One row per invoice (нэхэмжлэх) to a tenant or owner under a contract; answers invoice counts, amounts, ageing and payment-status questions.

issueDate.description: Invoice issue date; truncated to the hour

dueDate.description: Due date; truncated to the hour

expectedPayDate.description: Payment date planned by the user; truncated to the hour

approvedAt.description: Approval time; truncated to the hour

approvedBy.description: UUID token of the person recorded in this column;

myproperty_invoicepayment.description: Application of a payment to an invoice (no update timestamp in source);

invoiceId.description: Invoice the amount is applied to

paymentId.description: Payment applied; nullable for applications coming from tenantBalance or deposits

myproperty_owner.description: Property or unit owner (өмчлөгч) registry for office management, one row per owner; names, register numbers and contacts are not copied.

id.description: Person token (the userId other tables of this system carry) - count only

userId.description: UUID token of user in the central User Service (global user, unique by phone);

myproperty_payment.description: One row per payment received from a tenant or owner; answers payment volume, amount and method questions.

paymentDate.description: Payment date; truncated to the hour

method.description: Payment instrument, e.g. BANK_TRANSFER, QPAY, CREDIT, ADJUSTMENT, DEPOSIT, DISCOUNT, CASH. It is the instrument, not the channel/app

myproperty_rentalagreement.description: One row per rental agreement of a room between an owner and a tenant (түрээслэгч) under a management contract; used for tenancy duration and tenant/owner transitions.

managementContractId.description: Management contract the agreement falls under

startDate.description: Agreement start date; truncated to the hour

endDate.description: Agreement end date; truncated to the hour

terminatedAt.description: Termination time; truncated to the hour

createdBy.description: UUID token of the person recorded in this column;

myproperty_room.description: One row per room/unit in a building; answers stock-of-units questions by type, usage and area. Mostly commercial: few rows are dwellings.

type.description: Room type, self-describing codes: PARK = garage (граж), STORAGE = warehouse (агуулах), APARTMENT = dwelling (сууц), OFFICE/SHOP/MARKET/CLINIC/RESTAURANT/HOTEL/…

hasMeter.description: Whether the room has a meter

createdAt.description: Room record creation time; truncated to the hour

id.description: Person token (the userId other tables of this system carry) - count only

myproperty_tenant.description: Tenant (түрээслэгч) registry linking to the central user service by userId, one row per tenant; answers tenant counts and growth. Names, register numbers and contacts are not copied.

createdAt.description: Record creation time; truncated to the hour

updatedAt.description: Record last update time; truncated to the hour

id.description: Person token (the userId other tables of this system carry) - count only

userId.description: UUID token of user in the central User Service (global user, unique by phone);

parkly_park.description: One row per parkly park (parking facility) of a branch; answers park type, capacity, paid/unpaid and parent/child structure. Park name, register and bank account fields are not copied.

parkType.description: Park type, enum: Хотхон (residential complex) | Оффис (office) | Төлбөртэй зогсоол (paid parking) | Хүргэлт (delivery).

park_uuid.description: UUID of the park in the source system (NOT NULL); a source identifier, not a platform token.

createdAt.description: Created timestamp (truncated to the hour).

parkly_parkaccessconfig.description: One row per park's access configuration: configured counts and limits of permanent and temporary cars. it holds configured counts, not actual entries.

permaCar.description: Configured number of cars with permanent access. A count, not a car reference.

tempCar.description: Configured number of temporary-access cars. A count, not a car reference.

createdAt.description: Created timestamp (truncated to the hour).

sma_aiinfos.description: One row per AI assistant (AI туслах) profile of a user (source AiInfos); counts users with an AI assistant profile.

robotLogo.description: Logo of the AI assistant ('robot') profile

createdAt.description: Row creation time in the source; truncated to the hour

updatedAt.description: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

userId.description: UUID token of the sma user

sma_auctionsubscriptionbills.description: One row per auction subscription bill for a sale/rent listing (source AuctionSubscriptionBills, FK to PropertySaleRents); paid bills are the auction part of rental brokerage commission income. Which status values mean '…

propertySaleRentId.description: Listing the bill is for (FK to PropertySaleRents.id)

createdAt.description: Bill creation time; truncated to the hour

updatedAt.description: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

userId.description: UUID token of the sma user

sma_cars.description: One row per car registered in the sma app (source Cars), loaded without plateNumber;

importDate.description: Import date of the car; truncated to the hour

createdAt.description: Row creation time in the source; truncated to the hour

updatedAt.description: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

id.description: Person token (the userId other tables of this system carry) - count only

sma_directoffers.description: One row per direct offer (source DirectOffers, FK to Users); the paid direct offers are the direct-offer part of rental brokerage commission income, filtered on paidAt.

towns.description: Towns of the offer (JSON in the source)

paidAt.description: Payment time; truncated to the hour

createdAt.description: Row creation time in the source; truncated to the hour

updatedAt.description: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

userId.description: UUID token of the sma user

sma_iotsubscriptions.description: One row per IoT (relay, релей) subscription of a user (source IotSubscriptions); answers activated relay subscriptions and their fee income by creation date. There is no payment-status column.

priceInfoId.description: Price/product id - points outside this database

startDate.description: Subscription start; truncated to the hour

endDate.description: Subscription end; truncated to the hour

createdAt.description: Subscription creation time; truncated to the hour

updatedAt.description: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

userId.description: UUID token of the sma user

sma_propertysalerents.description: One row per property sale or rent listing (source PropertySaleRents, FK to Users); answers rental/sale listings by town, type and stage - grouped by town, there is no 'complex grade' field.

propertyType.description: Property type of the listing (free varchar in the source, not an enum)

createdAt.description: Time the listing was created; truncated to the hour

updatedAt.description: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

stage.description: Listing stage (indexed with expiresAt as 'active' in the source)

expiresAt.description: Listing expiry time; truncated to the hour

userId.description: UUID token of the sma user who posted the listing

sma_smaerrors.description: answers app error counts and affected users and error-free user share. The error text itself is dropped.

createdAt.description: Time the error was recorded; truncated to the hour

updatedAt.description: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

userId.description: UUID token of the sma user who hit the error

sma_useractionlogs.description: One row per user action logged in the app (source UserActionLogs); the activity source - 'active user' = has an action log in the period.

action.description: Action recorded in the log entry

createdAt.description: Time the action was logged; truncated to the hour

updatedAt.description: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

screen.description: App screen the action was logged on

userId.description: UUID token of the sma user

sma_usercars.description: Link table: one row per user-car pair (source UserCars, composite key userId+carId);

createdAt.description: Time the user-car link was created; truncated to the hour

updatedAt.description: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

userId.description: UUID token of the sma user

sma_users.description: One row per registered sma app user (source table Users); answers total users, new users per period and is the denominator for active-user share. Has no status/active column and no DAN-verification column, so 'active' a…

createdAt.description: Registration date of the user; truncated to the hour

updatedAt.description: Row last-update time in the source; truncated to the hour

id.description: Person token (the userId other tables of this system carry) - count only

createdAt.description: Row creation time (Sequelize timestamps). Truncated to the hour.

updatedAt.description: Row last-update time (Sequelize timestamps); the load watermark. Truncated to the hour.

smartpay_invoice.description: One row per SmartPay invoice (Invoices & payment domain): who paid (user token), which merchant, amounts, fee and payment type — answers users / invoices / fee income questions.

productPaymentType.description: Product payment type category. which value is which is not yet confirmed by smartpay.

createdAt.description: Row creation time (Sequelize timestamps). Truncated to the hour.

updatedAt.description: Row last-update time (Sequelize timestamps); the load watermark. Truncated to the hour.

smartpay_transaction.description: One row per payment transaction (Transactions & settlement domain) with its amount and the fee split (merchant / SmartPay / Xpay / processing) — answers fee-income questions. Account numbers are excluded.

invoiceItemId.description: Invoice item id (no FK declared on this column; the declared link is invoiceItem.transactionId -> transaction.id).

settledAt.description: Settlement time. Truncated to the hour.

type.description: Transaction type. NULL on almost all rows; which value marks a 'bundled' payment is unconfirmed.

createdAt.description: Row creation time (Sequelize timestamps). Truncated to the hour.

updatedAt.description: Row last-update time (Sequelize timestamps); the load watermark. Truncated to the hour.

esukh_balance.description: Large billing balance table. It has no update timestamp.

prevBalance.description: Balance before this row - not additive

monthBalance.description: Balance for the month - not additive

paymentBalance.description: Balance after this row - take the LATEST row per property, never SUM across rows

priceSum.description: Calculated service charge (configuration), NOT a payment - never add to balance

isApprove.description: Approval flag; changes after the row is inserted.

regDate.description: Row creation timestamp; it is not a change watermark. Truncated to the hour.

esukh_branch.description: One row per СӨХ (apartment owners' association) - the organisation register (table comment 'СӨХ -ны сан'); use it for organisation-level attributes such as location (province/district), service type and contract dates. …

province.description: Province (аймаг) id in reference; reference.root of the district should equal this, but 8 of 432 rows have a district outside the province, mostly Чингэлтэй дү…

district.description: District (дүүрэг) id in reference; its reference.root is its parent province. See the province/district mismatch bug (8 of 432 rows).

createdAt.description: Truncated to the hour.

esukh_property.description: Answers how many properties exist per branch/apartment and of which propertyType.

isDeleted.description: Soft-delete flag; defaults to 1 in esukh, so do NOT filter on it

propertyType.description: Property type: 1 = сууц (dwelling), 2 = гараж (garage), 3 = агуулах (storage) - confirmed

esukh_group.description: Groups; target of groupapartment.groupId and grouptown.groupId (declared FKs).

createdAt.description: Truncated to the hour.

createdUserId.description: UUID token of the user who created the group.

parkly_group.description: Car groups referenced by carConfig.groupId and groupDiscount.groupId (FKs). The name is not copied.

createdAt.description: Created timestamp (truncated to the hour).

esukh_userfeedback.description: One row per feedback item a resident submitted (metadata only: tag, status, open/close times; the text is not loaded)

closedByType.description: Who closed it: ADMIN or USER

userId.description: UUID token of the user (count only)
